finalText:
Found it: `processOrder` in `src/jobs/processOrder.js` acquired a connection but only released it on success, so any failed order left the connection stuck in-use forever.

The logs matched exactly — each `invalid order payload` job bumped `pool in-use` by one and it never came back down, until the pool hit 5/5 and started throwing `pool exhausted`, then the workers and API gave up around 2am.

Fixed by wrapping the run call in `try/finally`, same pattern the API handler already used via `withConnection`. All 4 tests pass now.
